correctness.rationale: PASS: For support S of the vertex component, each connected component of G[S] contributes one proportionality coordinate to ker ad_x, every external neighbor is forced zero, and vertices outside N[S] are unconstrained, giving rank |N[S]|-c(G[S]). On the cycle, proper nonempty supports have rank |S|+number of zero-runs of length >=2, recorded by cyclic 100 patterns; all-one support has rank n-1. The four-state transfer trace weights each indexed cyclic binary word, with the displayed all-one correction and q^n central multiplicity. At t=1/q, the transfer characteristic polynomial is λ(λ-p)(λ²-λ-p), yielding the exact commutativity degree. The bounded stationary 2-dependent Bernoulli triple statistic has positive variance pr(5p^4-15p³+21p²-14p+4) and a genuine m-dependent CLT; the cyclic and all-one corrections are bounded. Independent direct bracket-matrix finite-field elimination for q=2,3 and n<=6 exactly reproduced support ranks and moments (C1_OK). The finite tests are not the all-n proof.
